objectives.description: Explain the meaning and scope of business and distinguish between different types of business activities
Identify and classify types of occupations and explain their contributions to economic life
Describe the divisions of commerce including trade (home and foreign) and aids to trade
Explain forms of business ownership (sole proprietorship, partnership, cooperative, limited liability company)
Describe business transactions and identify common business documents (invoice, receipt, cheque, order form)

subStrands.name: Banking, Insurance, Transport, Communication, and Advertising

objectives.description: Explain the functions of commercial banks and describe banking services available to individuals and businesses
Describe insurance as an aid to trade, types of insurance, and the benefits of insurance to businesses
Explain the role of transportation in facilitating trade and describe modes of transport used in Nigeria
Describe communication methods in business and explain their importance in facilitating trade
Explain the purpose of advertising, its types, and its impact on business and consumer behaviour
Describe channels of distribution (producer → wholesaler → retailer → consumer) and the functions of each

subStrands.name: Books of Account and Double Entry

objectives.description: Explain the importance of bookkeeping and the qualities of a good bookkeeper
Identify and use source documents (invoice, receipt, voucher) and describe how they are recorded in special journals
Apply the double entry principle to record business transactions in the cash book, petty cash book, and ledger
Prepare a trial balance and explain its purpose in verifying arithmetical accuracy of ledger entries
Prepare simple Trading, Profit and Loss accounts and a Balance Sheet to determine business performance

subStrands.name: Business Plans, Consumer Rights, and Personal Finance

objectives.description: Define entrepreneurship and describe the personal qualities and skills of a successful entrepreneur
Identify business opportunities at local, national, and international levels and explain how to evaluate them
Write a simple business plan including objectives, market analysis, resources, and financial projections
Explain the eight universal rights of consumers and describe the responsibilities consumers have
Describe personal finance concepts including needs versus wants, scale of preference, saving, and modesty
Identify and use keyboarding skills correctly including proper posture, home row technique, and alphanumeric key functions
